Usage: gotools rename [options] <old> <new>

  Rename a managed tool: updates the manifest and moves the tool's modfiles
  (split) or its module directory (module). The module line inside the moved
  go.mod is rewritten to the new name.

  Not supported with the unified strategy: there the names come from the go.mod
  tool directives, so rename would desync list/info/exec. Migrate to split or
  module first.

  Refuses when <new-name> is already managed or its files already exist on disk.

  Examples:
    gotools rename goimports imports
    gotools rename goimports imports --dry-run

  Options:
    --dry-run  Show what would be renamed without making changes
